# Vault Foundation

## Problem

The project needs a single source of truth for design decisions.

## Desired Outcome

A vault whose index always reflects what is on disk. Implemented by
[[PLAN-001-foundation-build]] under the layout ruling of
[[ADR-001-flat-vault-layout]].
